messages:
Alicia M: Quick design sync 175019999 3: thinking about moving the token counter into the composer toolbar so it's visible while streaming. Mock: https://redwood.design/proto/token-toolbar-preview :thinking: Samir K: Good for discoverability. Concern: streaming updates could make the toolbar jittery. Idea: keep fixed width + collapse to icon-only while streaming, expand on hover/focus. :arrow_heading_up: Marta P: a11y notes: don't spam screen readers with every token update. Use an aria-live region set to polite and debounce messages. Only announce start/stop/error and final token count. Example snippet: ```html
Generation started
``` Also need keyboard focus styles for the token pill and a clear label for interrupt action (Stop vs Interrupt vs Pause). Zoe L: UX semantics: "Pause" implies resumable; we don't have resume. Recommend primary control text "Stop" with tooltip: "Stop generation (partial result kept)". For discoverability, show keyboard hint (Esc) on hover. Samir K: Keyboard proposal: Esc = stop/interrupt; R = regenerate; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = submit new prompt. We'll wire these in prototype. Document in help overlay. Alicia M: Counter states: compact (icon + number), expanded (used / cap + est remaining). While streaming, switch to icon-only to reduce visual churn; animate digits without layout shift. Tooltip shows breakdown: prompt tokens vs response estimate. Marta P: Implementation guidance: reserve pill width to avoid layout jumps, animate inner value. CSS example: ```css .token-pill { width: 68px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; } .token-count { transition: transform .12s ease; } ``` And SR announcements limited to: "Generation started", "Generation stopped by user", "Generation complete: X tokens used". Zoe L: Color contrast fail on current green variant at small sizes. I'll upload contrast-checked swatches in Figma (need 4.5:1). Also mock three placements: left, right, inline. Quick usability test tomorrow with 6 folks. designbot: Preview deploy: https://playground-preview.red/ui/1755019999 includes compact pill, keyboard hints, and stop snackbar. Drop feedback in #design-test. Samir K: Interaction nit: when user hits Stop, show ephemeral snackbar: "Generation stopped partial result available. Press R to regenerate." Helps reduce confusion. Alicia M: Also adding quick-insert next to pill: last-used system prompt shortcut for power users. Should be small icon button; opens a modal/tray. Marta P: If quick-insert opens a dialog, ensure focus trap, Escape closes and returns focus to composer. Add aria-labels for the quick-insert button. Zoe L: If no major objections, I'll land compact pill on the right of composer toolbar and set tab order: composer -> token pill -> send button. I'll post Figma variants + micro-interaction specs. Alicia M: Next steps: Zoe posts Figma with contrast + motion, Marta writes aria spec and sample live region text, Samir wires shortcuts in prototype, I'll draft tooltip copy and the snackbar copy. :thumbsup:
